headline: Three open days closed in one push: Monday was rest, Tuesday and Wednesday were both gym, and you are the freshest you have been since the race.
body:
The sync landed at **21:31** last night after **66 hours** dark, and the backfill rewrites every day I had to leave open. Monday: no file, **3,594 steps**, body battery recovering to 100 - a real rest day. Tuesday and Wednesday: Cardio logs of **74** and **83 minutes**, mean bucket-to-bucket step **11.4** and **12.4 bpm** against the ~5 bpm plateau line, so both are gym and nothing endurance is hiding in either.

HRV is **79 against a 69.0 14-day mean** and this is the third morning above it; RHR **44** against a 43 best. Green.

The wind spends it for you, though. Gusts **70 early, 73 midday, 65 evening** - road bike and open water are both off today. Pool instead: **2,000 m at 2:00-2:10/100 m**. Friday before 11:00 is your one clean window all week at a **35** gust, so put the ride there - Saturday gusts **91**.

Still owed: the ankle, and no run file since **13 September**.
